One small comment only. Possibly we should add "confirm" method call for every step? The way it is implemented now, It always performs all cleanup, but maybe it's enough to only do some of that and get interactive. That can be paired with `--answer` flag:

* `breeze doctor` -> interactively asking about each step allowing to `y` -> do it, `n` -> skip it, `q` -> quit the process
* `breeze doctor --answer y` -> perform complete cleanup

review_comments: One more thing - addding `@dry_run` and `@verbose` will allow to print commands while executing or just showig what would have happened. This should work out-of-the-box with `run_command` and friends, but some care should be taken and `ifs` added to direct `rmtree` and similar.

@potiuk Since most of the function calls work out of the box with the `@option_verbose` and `@option_dry_run` decorators, I have added these now to breeze doctor and seems to work as expected. Please review the changes and let me know your thoughts!
